description: Exact names of every temporary/aux file the worker creates. Anything starting with '.ck-' in an output folder is a worker temp file; output file names never start with '.'. The worker removes ONLY temp files it created itself in this job (exclusive create); a same-named pre-existing file is never touched and makes the job fail/reject.

locations.output_tmp: same folder as the final file; <final_sha1_12> = first 12 hex of sha1(utf-8 of the final path string as sent, normalised to the worker OS)
locations.probe: every distinct output folder, before inference
